tasks.label: workspace:preview-purge-stale-artifacts
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; repo='${workspaceFolder}'; echo '[preview] repo='"$repo"; echo '[preview] .nextflow cache:'; find "$repo" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '.nextflow' -print; echo '[preview] nextflow logs:'; find "$repo" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.nextflow.log*' -print | sort; echo '[preview] work dirs:'; find "$repo" -type d -name 'work' -print | sort; echo '[preview] deprecated test sample sheets:'; find "$repo" -type f \( -path '*/tests/samples_*banked_stage*.yaml' -o -name 'samples_*deprecated*.yaml' \) -print | sort

tasks.label: workspace:purge-stale-artifacts
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; repo='${workspaceFolder}'; rm -rf "$repo/.nextflow"; find "$repo" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.nextflow.log*' -delete; find "$repo" -type d -name 'work' -prune -exec rm -rf {} +; find "$repo" -type f \( -path '*/tests/samples_*banked_stage*.yaml' -o -name 'samples_*deprecated*.yaml' \) -delete; echo '[purge] completed for' "$repo"
